title: Subscapularis Repair Augmentation for Total Shoulder Arthroplasty
official: Augmentation of Subscapularis Repair in Total Shoulder Arthroplasty
summary: The primary purpose of this research is to compare the images obtained by ultrasound between a standard repair of the subscapularis tissue and after repair with a Biobrace. The secondary purpose is to determine if there are any clinical differences.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Total Shoulder Arthroplasty

Exclusion Criteria:

* Vulnerable population
